dct_description_sm: Data was collected in order to investigate the long-term and seasonal responses of dissolved solute concentrations, and solute fluxes in the watersheds at Cape Bounty Arctic Watershed Observatory to permafrost change and climate variability. Samples were collected from the two main rivers and several tributary sites subject to varying degrees of disturbance.
dct_title_s: 2016-2019 River Dissolved inorganic ion concentrations, Cape Bounty Arctic Watershed Observatory (CBAWO), Melville Island, Nunavut
